plain: The five things you name to describe an information flow: sender, recipient, subject, type of information and the condition it travels under.
eli5: Who tells, who hears, who it is about, what it is, and the rule for sharing it.
technical: The five parameters of a contextual-integrity flow or norm: sender, recipient and data subject (the actors), information type (attribute) and transmission principle; a well-formed norm fills all five.
